headline: As of 2026-10-23: 22,022,751 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 46 of 50 states, D+13.1 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 22,022,751 early/mail ballots cast so far across 46 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+13.1 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (2,753,827), California (2,473,816), Florida (2,016,420).
